votes.motion: Accept the Cemetery Commission's nominee Michael Clark
votes.quote: michael ray jeffery made a motion to vote on accepting the cemetery commission's nominee - michael clark. it was an anonymous vote of both the members of the select board and the cemetery commission present at the joint meeting. motion passed 7 to 0.
